SELECT CAST(c.dwxz AS CHAR) AS code, COUNT(DISTINCT j.jobid) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.syn_rag = 1 THEN j.jobid END) AS synced FROM t_biz_jobs_info j INNER JOIN t_biz_compary_info c ON j.yrdw = c.zzjgdm LEFT JOIN t_biz_jobs_rag_sync r ON j.jobid = r.jobid WHERE c.dwxz IS NOT NULL
